title: Ali Asghar Ka Janaza Hai
body:
Ali Asghar Ka Janaza Hai Shabbir Ko Pursa Do
<<DIVIDER>>
Khawhish Hai Sakina Ki (x2) Sughra Ko He Bulwa Do.
<<DIVIDER>>
Pooch Hai Sakina Ne Baba Sai Ye Hasrat Hai (x2)
Mayyat Pe Mein Jhirkoungi (x2)
Ek Jaam Mujhe Laado.
<<DIVIDER>>
Asghar Ka Galla Zakhmi Aur Ma Ka Jigger Chalni (x2)
Kitnay Hi Jainazay Hain (x2)
Hurmal Ko Yeh Samjha Do.
<<DIVIDER>>
Thanha Hai Khara Run Main Koee Bhi Nahi Sathi (x2)
Shabbir Bulla Thay Hain (x2)
Roo-thay Howay Shehzadon
